exposure: Physical facilities (beds, blood bank, one-stop crisis management center, birthing and caesarean section facilities)
Specific disaster plans (surge capacity, infectious disease outbreak, fire safety)
outcome: Inclusion of specific sub-plans within disaster plans
cohort: The study included 25 designated Hub Hospitals across Nepal.
finding: The study revealed varying levels of disaster preparedness among the 25 Hub Hospitals in Nepal, with most having a general disaster plan but inconsistencies in specific sub-plans and resource availability.
mod_finding: Birthing facilities and capabilities for caesarean section were available in all 25 hub hospitals.
